meta.title: SecurePrompt Console
meta.description: SecurePrompt Console — the control plane for the LLM security gateway: redact secrets and PII, enforce policy, and track token usage, cost, and governance across AI providers.

login.subtitle: Access the SecurePrompt Console — redact secrets & PII, enforce policy, and monitor LLM usage, cost, and governance.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Gateway access keys used by client applications. Full keys are shown only once at creation — copy them immediately.

providersPage.title: Providers
providersPage.description: LLM provider credentials used by the gateway. Credentials are encrypted at rest; only the prefix is ever returned.

secureModePage.title: Secure Mode
secureModePage.description: Workspace-level security controls applied to every LLM request routed through the gateway.

semanticSearch.title: Semantic Policy Search
semanticSearch.description: Test whether a prompt matches any indexed policy rules via vector search.
semanticSearch.promptPlaceholder: Enter a prompt to check against indexed policy rules…
semanticSearch.noWorkspace: No active workspace — sign in again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage API keys, AI providers, and policy enforcement rules.

workspaceSettings.title: Workspace Budget
workspaceSettings.description: Set daily and monthly token limits for this workspace. Limits are enforced at the gateway level before requests reach AI providers.

profileSettings.title: Profile
profileSettings.description: Personal info displayed in the dashboard. Email and role are managed by the workspace owner — contact them to change either.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.description: Every request routed through the gateway — filter to violations with the toggle below.
audit.pageAndRows: Page {page} · {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

auditDetail.title: Request Detail
auditDetail.loadFailed: Failed to load request detail. The request may have been purged (90-day TTL) or the ID is invalid.
auditDetail.whoDescription: Workspace member that issued this request.
auditDetail.fromDescription: Transport — source, IP, device that sent it.
auditDetail.policyDescription: Rules that fired against this request. Empty when no policy triggered.
auditDetail.userMessageDescription: What the user typed (raw) and what the gateway forwarded upstream (redacted). Only the latest turn — prior conversation history is intentionally excluded.
auditDetail.panelRedactedPromptDescription: Forwarded upstream — PII replaced with {'{{'}Class_N{'}}'} placeholders.
auditDetail.panelRedactedPromptEmpty: No redacted output (request didn't reach redaction).
auditDetail.aiResponseDescription: What the upstream model emitted (raw, placeholders intact) and what the client received (after placeholder restoration).
auditDetail.panelRawResponseDescription: Direct from the upstream model — placeholders not yet restored.
auditDetail.panelRawResponseEmpty: No upstream response (denied, embedding-only, or pre-migration row).
auditDetail.panelRestoredResponseDescription: What the client saw — placeholders mapped back to original PII.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Audit trail of all LLM requests proxied through SecurePrompt.
requests.loadFailed: Failed to load requests. The API may be unavailable.
requests.empty: No requests found for the selected filters.

requestDetail.title: Request Detail
requestDetail.noPolicyEvents: No policy events for this request.

fileScan.title: File Scan & Secure
fileScan.description: Scan documents for PII, secrets, and prompt injection — or secure a file and download a redacted copy in its original format.
fileScan.acceptedFormats: Scan reads .txt, .pdf, .docx. Secure & download also supports images and .xlsx (max 15 MB).
fileScan.secureExplainer: Securing redacts PII & secrets in place, covering each value with a labelled black box, and returns the file in its original format. The redaction is one-way — the original text is removed, not hidden.
fileScan.entityTitleRepeated: max score: {score} · {count, plural, one {# occurrence} other {# occurrences}}
fileScan.securedWithDetail: ✓ Secured — {count, plural, one {# entity} other {# entities}} redacted{pages, plural, =0 {} one { across # page} other { across # pages}}{ocr, select, yes { (OCR)} other {}}. Downloaded {filename}.

error.tooManyScans: Too many scans in progress — try again in a moment.
error.tooManySecures: Too many secure jobs in progress — try again in a moment.
error.modelLoading: Model still loading — try again in a moment.
error.jobExpired: The job expired — please try again.
error.scanTimedOut: Scan timed out — the document may be very large.
error.secureTimedOut: Securing timed out — the document may be very large.
error.noResult: Scan finished but returned no result.

secureMode.masterDescription: Master switch for all workspace-level security controls. When off, the gateway still logs traffic but applies no redaction or blocking.
secureMode.levelDescription: Controls how aggressively the gateway reacts to detections.
secureMode.level_permissive_hint: Log detections but never block. Good for onboarding.
secureMode.level_standard_hint: Redact PII/secrets in-flight. Block only on high-confidence violations.
secureMode.level_strict_hint: Block the request on any PII, secret, or injection detection.
secureMode.togglesLockedPermissive: Block toggles are forced off at Permissive level.
secureMode.togglesLockedStrict: Block toggles are forced on at Strict level.
secureMode.togglesLockedHint: Switch to Standard to control them individually.
secureMode.blockPiiHint: Reject the request when personal data (names, emails, SSNs, etc.) is detected.
secureMode.blockInjectionHint: Reject the request when the ML sidecar flags likely prompt injection (requires ML sidecar).
secureMode.redactResponsesHint: Scan model completions and replace PII with opaque tokens before returning to the caller.
secureMode.readOnlyNotice: You have {role} access — only admins and owners can modify secure-mode settings.

entityPicker.title: PII types to redact
entityPicker.summaryNone: No types selected — nothing will redact.

tokenize.title: Tokenize / Detokenize
tokenize.description: Round-trip PII through the ML sidecar. Originals are stored in a workspace-scoped vault and expire after 24 hours.
tokenize.pickAtLeastOne: Pick at least one PII type to redact.
tokenize.inputPlaceholder: Email bob@example.com from +1 (415) 555-0104 about the $12k invoice…
tokenize.vaultIdPlaceholder: UUID from a previous tokenize call

keys.title: API Keys
keys.description: Keys are shown with prefix only — the full key is revealed once at creation.
keys.readOnlyNotice: Only owners and admins can create or revoke keys.
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke key "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
keys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to get started.
keys.copyNowWarning: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again.
keys.assigneeHint: Assigned keys are encrypted at rest; the chat client fetches them server-to-server when the member logs in. The member never types or sees the raw key.

members.title: Workspace Members
members.description: Everyone with access to this workspace. Admins can invite new members.
members.inviteDescription: The new account is created immediately with the password you set — share it with the member out-of-band and ask them to change it on first login.
members.ownerRoleHint: Owner role is assigned automatically at workspace creation and cannot be granted from this form.

policyRules.title: Policy Rules
policyRules.description: Rules are evaluated in priority order (lower number = higher priority). Use dry-run to test without enforcement.
policyRules.readOnlyNotice: Only owners and admins can add or edit policy rules.
policyRules.empty: No policy rules. Create one to start enforcing policies.
policyRules.priorityConflict: Priority already in use. Choose a different value.

providers.title: AI Providers
providers.description: Manage provider credentials. Credentials are stored encrypted and are never exposed in API responses.
providers.readOnlyNotice: Only owners and admins can add or edit providers.
providers.fieldProjectPlaceholder: leave blank to use the SA key's project
providers.fieldApiKeyExisting: API Key (leave blank to keep existing)
providers.adcHint: Optional — uses Workload Identity / ADC if blank
providers.testSucceeded: ✓ Connected ({count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}})

providerModels.title: Models
providerModels.description: Auto-fetched from the provider's API key on save. Removed models stay removed across syncs. Add one back manually below, or click Sync to pull newly-released upstream models.
providerModels.alreadyInSync: Already in sync ({count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} tracked).
providerModels.synced: Synced — added {count, plural, one {# new model} other {# new models}} ({total} total).
providerModels.removedCount: Removed {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}

license.title: License
license.description: View your current license status and activate or remove a token.
license.readOnlyNotice: Only owners and admins can activate or remove a license.
license.forbidden: You need owner or admin access to view license status.
license.removeConfirm: Remove the database license? The gateway will fall back to the environment token (if any).

securitySettings.title: Two-factor authentication
securitySettings.description: Add an extra layer of protection with an authenticator app, or turn it off below if you already have it enabled.
securitySettings.startSetupFailed: Couldn't start setup. Please try again.
securitySettings.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
securitySettings.protecting: Two-factor authentication is protecting your account.
securitySettings.setupHint: Scan the QR code below with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, etc.), then enter the 6-digit code it generates to turn it on.
securitySettings.backupCodesHint: If you lose access to your authenticator app, each code can be used once in its place. They won't be shown again after this screen.
securitySettings.disableHint: Enter a current authenticator code or a backup code to confirm.

budgetSettings.dailyLimitHint: Leave blank for no daily limit.
budgetSettings.monthlyLimitHint: Leave blank for no monthly limit.
budgetSettings.behavior_block_description: Return HTTP 402 when the limit is exceeded.
budgetSettings.behavior_warn_description: Allow through but add X-SecurePrompt-Budget-Warning header.
budgetSettings.behavior_flag_description: Allow through silently; flag in analytics only.
